name: Tinasha's Mastery

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Countermass
perks.desc:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Quick Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's barrel provides faster projectiles and much faster aiming.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Smart Drift Control
perks.desc:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.desc: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: High-Explosive Ordnance
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are larger and travel faster.
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases magazine size

perks.name: Air Trigger
perks.desc: Increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are increased but target acquisition is decreased.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.desc: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.desc: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

perks.name: Loose Change
perks.desc: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for a short duration.

perks.name: Reverberation
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for a short duration.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.desc: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Skulking Wolf
perks.desc: While at low health, final blows with this weapon grant enhanced radar, remove you from opposing Guardians' radar, and make combatants less aggressive toward you.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 124 from 19 November 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3n08KP410ui1TXoEdBmsvu?si=2badf5a8fcac408d) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-Champion PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice utility PvE pick use against Champion enemies in general, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with Stasis builds. Probably the most chased-after Iron Banner PvE weapon in years, Tinasha's Mastery is the first Stasis rocket-assisted sidearm. At base the stats are solid - 28 Range equates to 14.56m when ADS and 12.12m hipfire (although there really isn't that much damage dropoff), 42 Handling is 0.31s ready, 0.25s ADS and 0.35s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 29 is a 1.81s reload. Magazine size is 10 (maximum 16), and with 0/1/2/3 reserves mods you get total ammo of 40/43/46/48 (max 57). This roll is all about slowing and freezing single targets, so Velocity is far more important to boost than Blast Radius with the barrel and magazine perks. In the first perk trait slot, Air Trigger provides the equivalent of 1.5 reserves mods (2 when enhanced) - useful since the nerf to reserve ammo - as well as speedy reloads if you're in the air when the animation starts. All of this is building up to Chill Clip in the second trait perk column - one shot slows, and disrupts, Overload Champions and three shots freezes, and stuns, Unstoppable champions, which you can synergise with Stasis fragments. Apply Radiant and it'll pierce Barrier champions too. It's bound to be nerfed at some point, so enjoy being totally overpowered for as long as it lasts. With the change to the Skulking Wolf origin trait, at least there is now an effect in PvE to reduce enemy accuracy when it's procced, which could be useful for survivability in more difficult content. Recommended MW: Velocity with a Backup Mag mod or, when enhanced, a Synergy mod to generate Stasis shards or Stunloader when an artifact mod's around.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Tinasha’s Mastery will probably be one of a few weapons pulling PvE players into PvP. Being a Stasis rocket-assisted sidearm and the first of its kind it will definitely stand out amongst loadouts. Chill Clip and either Impulse Amplifier or Loose Change will be the standout perk combinations but One for All or Frenzy are more neutral damage options." Recommended MW: Blast Radius or Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "While I'd advise against a rocket-assisted sidearm for the crucible, having ChillClip on an easy to fire weapon is undeniably strong. While you would need to stock up on ammo it's not entirely outside of the question to use." Recommended MW: Blast Radius.
